claims.claim_text: An official Army entry record confirms indexed Private First Class James C. Robinson by exact name and protected identifier.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The NARA index and Army bulk file agree on the exact name, middle initial, and a nonshared protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact-name, middle-initial, and exact private-identifier agreement between two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes identity but does not establish an employer or immediate OSS sequence.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier and coded occupation remain private; no employer is inferred from the coded Army field.
